tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Search the Spark AI assets marketplace. Returns matching agents, skills, prompts, MCP connectors, and bundles. [Trial mode: limited to 5 results. Set SPARK_API_KEY for full access: https://spark.entire.vc/create]

job.description: Job/task the agent is trying to accomplish. Enables job-based relevance ranking (e.g. 'review Python code', 'generate marketing copy', 'analyze data'). Recommended for agent use.

sort.description: Sort order. 'combo' = combined quality+ratings score (default, recommended).

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Get full details of a Spark asset by its slug. Returns description, content, files, ratings, and more.

tools.name: get_asset_content
tools.description: Get the raw content of a Spark asset (prompt text, skill instructions, agent config). Best for prompts and skills that have inline content.

tools.name: list_popular
tools.description: List the most popular Spark assets. Defaults to combined quality+ratings score (combo). Great for discovering top-rated AI tools.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List available categories (domains and AI tags) in the Spark marketplace. Useful for filtering searches.

tools.name: get_api_key_info
tools.description: Check your Spark API key status and daily usage. Shows how many assets you've served today and your remaining quota.

tools.name: submit_review
tools.description: Submit a review for a Spark asset after using it. Helps improve ranking for future agent recommendations. session_id should be a stable identifier for your current session/run.

slug.description: Asset slug to review (same slug used in get_asset)

session_id.description: Your session or run ID (for deduplication — one review per session per asset)

outcome.description: Did the asset accomplish the job? success=fully worked, partial=partially helped, failure=did not help

accuracy.description: How accurate/correct was the output? 1=many errors, 5=perfect
